people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Libnah
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua; a Levitical city

translations.web: Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it.
translations.bsb: And Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish. They laid siege to it and fought against it.
